arms.baseline: existing 5:5 retrieval baseline and configured HG behavior
arms.parallel: question plan → per-request 5:5 retrieval, merge, rerank and existing final selector

definitions.candidate: baseline: initial original-question candidate pool; parallel: that pool merged with candidates retrieved from valid planned request queries; the candidate-stage label is the arm-level pool entering source/context expansion.
definitions.expanded: The arm-specific selected/expanded source-page set after request-level retrieval and source expansion, before the final 8-page/8,000-token packing step.
definitions.final: full evidence in the packed final context
definitions.paired_delta: improved = baseline incomplete and parallel complete; lost = baseline complete and parallel incomplete

limitations: Evaluation uses existing citation/fact rules; it does not grade answer correctness.
The semantic review is a single-reviewer diagnostic rather than validated gold.
The HG recognition proxy measures overlap with evidence-derived target/role labels, not whether the request was semantically understood.
Quote-limited cases remain scored as incomplete even when all cited pages are included; fix labels/scorer before treating those as retrieval failures.
Latency and call-count comparison are reported in the separate planned step 4, not recalculated here.

quote_limited_audit.method: existing scorer replay with every source page named in each peer evidence_groups; page contents from restored-page artifact. No new retrieval/model call or comparison arm.

scope: Re-analysis of the archived baseline vs question-plan/request-level retrieval comparison; no new retrieval run and no API calls.

peer_hg_proxy.interpretation: The expected target/role set is inferred only from peer citations whose evidence-group alternatives point to the same indexed HG case/role. This is an evidence-linked proxy, not independent intent gold; citation sets may omit relevant extra roles.

semantic_manual_plan_review.method: One reviewer compared generated planned targets/parts/scope against the original question. This manual review has no independent second adjudicator and is not the HG proxy.
